messages:
emma: Quick DS thread — the Dedicated dashboard filter row gets very crowded on smaller widths. Chips wrap to two lines and it looks noisy. Anyone else noticed this?

rachel: Yep. My thought: reduce horizontal padding on chips and add a compact variant + overflow + a "+N more" pill.

tom: I'm +1 for compact but must keep interactive targets >=40px. Maybe compress padding but keep min-height. Also truncate long labels with ellipses.

jess: Accessibility check: ghost buttons' focus ring is almost invisible at current colors. We should either increase thickness or use tokenized focus shadow with higher contrast.

emma: Another thing — toast stacking. When several toasts appear they push down the filter row and cause a layout shift. We should pin toasts above content and use absolute positioning so they don't reflow filters. Also set `pointer-events: none` on container except for the action buttons.

ui-bot: Screenshot uploaded: https://photos.app/s/AEexample (shows chips wrapping + toast overlap)

rachel: Copy nit on the toast that says "Indexing started" — users asked what indexing means. Suggest: "Preparing model assets (indexing) in background. You can continue working." That gives context.

tom: For spacing tokens proposal in the styleguide, I'm thinking:```
spacing.compact: 8px
spacing.default: 12px
spacing.comfort: 16px
```
This lets us have an explicit compact mode without touching all components.

jess: I'll add keyboard e2e tests: tab into filter row, use arrow keys to move between chips, ensure toasts do NOT steal focus when they appear. Also will test with VoiceOver + NVDA.

emma: Can we expose the compact chips behind a feature flag so PMs can opt-in? Also want a Storybook variant showing truncated labels + tooltip on hover.

rachel: I can sign off on compact if we ship the tooltip for truncated labels and confirm chip contrast >= 4.5:1.

tom: I'll open a PR with CSS, Storybook stories, and the flag `ui.chips_compact`. Will include screenshots and the token changes.

ui-bot: CI run for branch chips-compact-192 succeeded (build #412).

emma: Great. Targeting canary deploy next Wednesday. Can everyone review the PR by EOD Monday?

all: :thumbsup:
